Slop Image to 3D · In development

Image to 3D

Turn a picture into a 3D model. Runs on your device.

Open now

Slop Image to 3D has these main features: Height-field mesh from depth; Point cloud and splat view. It opens Any image.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.
